eb_welding_pressure.author: C. S. Punshon, TWI
eb_welding_pressure.scope: Targeted reading Introduction, Reduced pressure EB welding and Concluding remarks. Conventional working pressure around 0.001 mbar = 0.1 Pa; specially developed differential pumping permits working pressure up to about 1 mbar = 100 Pa. Gun vacuum and workpiece atmosphere differ; these are specific welding cases, not universal manufacturing limits.
